Project Documentation

API Reference

This document describes the public API for the library. All functions are documented with their signatures, parameters, and return types.

Installation

Add the dependency to your Cargo.toml:

[dependencies]
mylib = "2.0"

Core Functions

pub fn parse(input: &str) -> Result<Document, Error>

Parses a string input into a Document structure. This is the main entry point for the library.

Parameter Type Description
input &str The raw string to parse

Returns: A Result<Document, Error> where Document contains the parsed AST.

pub fn render(doc: &Document, format: OutputFormat) -> String

Renders a parsed document to the specified output format.

use mylib::{parse, render, OutputFormat};

let doc = parse("input text")?;
let output = render(&doc, OutputFormat::HTML);
println!("{}", output);

Error Handling

All functions return Result types. The Error enum includes:

  • Error::InvalidInput — the input string could not be parsed
  • Error::FormatError — the output format was not supported
  • Error::IoError — an I/O error occurred

Configuration

The library can be configured using the Config builder:

let config = Config::builder()
    .strict_mode(true)
    .max_depth(10)
    .build();
